description: This file defines the DictionaryDatabase class, which manages a searchable dictionary database using SQLite with FTS3 virtual table, including loading words from resources and providing query methods.

classes.name: DictionaryDatabase
classes.description: Manages a searchable SQLite FTS3 virtual table for dictionary words, including loading data and querying.

classes.name: DictionaryOpenHelper
classes.description: SQLiteOpenHelper subclass that creates and upgrades the dictionary database, and loads initial words from resources.

methods.name: buildColumnMap
methods.description: Creates a map of column aliases for query projection.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor for a specific word by rowId.

methods.name: getWordMatches
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor for words matching a query string.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query with given selection and columns.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the FTS virtual table and loads initial words.

methods.name: loadDictionary
methods.description: Starts a thread to load words into the database.

methods.name: loadWords
methods.description: Reads words from resource file and inserts into database.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Inserts a new word and definition into the database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping and recreating the table.
